DLPS Notify: Installation
=========================

1. Right-click (or Control-click) "Install.command" and choose "Open".
2. Click "Open" in the dialog. You only need this once, because Apple
   hasn't notarized the app.
3. DLPS Notify goes into your Applications folder and shows up in the
   menu bar as a little game controller (top right).

Done. From now on the app checks the site regularly and tells you about new
games and updates. Click the menu bar icon to:

  • see the latest games and updates (click one to open its page),
  • pick your platforms (PS2 / PS3 / PS4 / PS5 / PSN),
  • change how often it checks (15 / 30 / 60 minutes),
  • open the history or point it at your own game list,
  • start it at login.

No banners? Open System Settings → Notifications, find "terminal-notifier"
and turn it on. DLPS Notify sends its banners through it.

Source & updates: https://github.com/knutwurst/dlps-notify
